title: fix(relay): the courier skips lines from addon users; hold cleared only by a notice we map
expect: IsAddonUser|addon users?|switched off|turned off|disabled the addon|YOU_JOINED|YOU_CHANGED|never clear|not clear|stays? (blocked|held|silent)
why: Reverse of a53e4b8. A guildmate with the addon switched off (or broken) is an addon user whose client posts nothing, so skipping addon users loses their lines; and a successful join (YOU_JOINED/YOU_CHANGED) must clear the join hold or the client stays silent after a password fix.
